title: fix(plugin-kanban, plugin-gantt): phone kanban opens on its first non-empty column; narrow gantt bars show their title beside the bar
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8UjW5hY4zzDTaMsfZutCvCm)_
Fixes #27418

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:手机上的看板首次加载时,自动滚到第一个有卡片的列(列顺序不变,用户一动手就不再移动);甘特图上放不下标题的窄条,把完整标题画在条的右侧,宽条照旧在条内带省略号显示。
- 为什么改:HotCRM 18.2.0 手机走查第 12–13 行:管道看板打开停在空的第一阶段;月视图的条只有 18px,标题一个字都显示不出,连省略号都没有。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `plugin-kanban` 的平铺看板滚动器和 `plugin-gantt` 的条标题;桌面宽看板第一个有卡片的列已在视野内时不滚动,宽条(可用宽度 ≥96px)标题位置不变。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`KanbanImpl.tsx` 的 `initialColumnShownRef` 两个 effect;`GanttView.tsx` 的 `barLabelPlacement` 与两处标题渲染。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/phoneOpensOnFirstFilledColumn-27418.test.tsx packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.barLabelPlacement-27418.test.tsx`,预期 11 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Row 12, `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx` (flat board only).**

- On its first settled load (`recordsSettled`, and `boardWidth` measured so columns have their final width), the flat scroller brings the first column that holds a card into view. It moves by the distance between that column and the first one, from wherever the snap rests the board (Chromium rests a phone board at `scrollLeft: 16`).
- It is one-shot. It ends on the first settled load that holds a card, whether or not it scrolled, and on any `pointerdown` / `touchstart` / `wheel` / `keydown` on the scroller. A board that settles empty waits for its first card unless the viewer moved first.
- A column already fully in view is never scrolled to, so a wide desktop board is unchanged. Column order is unchanged. The swimlane layout is unchanged.

**Row 13, `ui/packages/plugin-gantt/src/GanttView.tsx` (bar titles).**

- `barLabelPlacement(barWidth, title)` puts the title inside the bar when the whole title fits after the bar's `px-2`, or when the bar has at least 96px of room for a truncated title. Otherwise the title is drawn beside the bar's end (`BESIDE_BAR_LABEL_CLASS`: `left-full`, one line, `text-foreground`, never truncated). The fit uses a per-character estimate at the label's 10px font (CJK 10px, other 5.5px, matching Chromium's measured widths). It only chooses the placement and never cuts the title.
- Applies to leaf bars and summary bars. Each label now carries `data-testid="gantt-bar-label-ID"` and `data-placement`.

## Why

Rows 12–13 of #27355 (HotCRM 18.2.0 at phone width), carded as #27418. Measured in real Chromium (`/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`) at 390x844 on a fixture page that renders `KanbanBoard` and `GanttView` from source with the console's Tailwind build. HotCRM's metadata was not used.

| Reading | Before (`45c9be5f`) | After |
|---|---|---|
| Kanban, stages 1–2 empty: column in view on first paint | `scrollLeft` 16, "Prospecting" (empty) | `scrollLeft` 756, "Proposal" (first with cards) |
| Kanban, stage 1 has cards | `scrollLeft` 16, "Prospecting" | `scrollLeft` 16, "Prospecting" (unchanged) |
| Gantt month, 18px bar, long title | label box 0px wide inside the bar: no text, no ellipsis | whole title beside the bar, 297px |
| Gantt week, 31px bar, "Holiday Email Nurture" | 13px inside: an ellipsis and a letter | whole title beside the bar, 104px |
| Gantt week, 63px bar, long title | 45px inside: "Q4 Ent…" | whole title beside the bar |
| Gantt month, 112px bar, "Trade Show Booth" | inside, whole | inside, whole (unchanged) |
| Task-list title cell, long title | `text-overflow: ellipsis`, `scrollWidth` 356 vs `clientWidth` 91 | unchanged |

## Acceptance notes

- **The task-list title already ellipsizes (premise not reproduced).** At 390px the title cell measured `text-overflow: ellipsis` with `scrollWidth` 356 over `clientWidth` 91, and it ellipsized latin, CJK and unbroken titles in week and month view. A phone opens the gantt with the task list collapsed (`width: 0`), so the bar was the only place a title showed; the "cut with no ellipsis" title in the report matches the bar label (0px of room in an 18px bar). The title cell is not changed. A test pins the two classes the reading rests on.
- Milestones (diamonds) draw no title before or after; not changed. The PNG/PDF export's `fitText` labels are not changed either.
- A beside title can sit under a bar's end connector dot while that dot shows on hover. The label is `pointer-events-none`, so the dot stays grabbable.
- The kanban's mobile dot indicator still estimates the active column as `scrollLeft / clientWidth`; it follows the new scroll position like any other scroll.
- Out of scope per the order: a gantt column-title config key (#27386 row 2).

## Verification

Head `0db321c7`.

- New tests: `phoneOpensOnFirstFilledColumn-27418.test.tsx` (6) and `GanttView.barLabelPlacement-27418.test.tsx` (5), all pass.
- Ablations (each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to the HEAD blob after):
  - Delete the kanban `scrollLeft` move: 3 tests fail (opens on third stage, waits then moves, never moves again).
  - Make the kanban `viewerMoved` handler a no-op: 1 test fails (never overrides a viewer who scrolled first).
  - Make `barLabelPlacement` always return `'inside'`: 2 tests fail (narrow leaf bar, narrow summary bar).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/plugin-gantt/` under the lock: 186 files passed, 1 skipped; 1320 tests passed, 114 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-kanban run type-check` and `@object-ui/plugin-gantt`: exit 0. eslint on the four changed files: 0 errors. `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.
